name: memhop-capability
summary: L5 capability loop manual: crystallize reusable abilities from L6 trajectories (draft) -> activate -> usage feedback, import external capability files, List/Get index and details (built-in cards are read-only)
trigger: need to distill reusable abilities, import capability definitions, activate drafts, record usage results, view the capability list or fetch card details; capability l5 crystallize import activate draft lifecycle

resources.name: Crystallize
resources.desc: Call after a session has accumulated enough L6 trajectory (same kind of operation seen twice or more); not on the interactive hot path; the product is a draft and must be reviewed and activated via ActivateCapability
resources.input: {"type":"object","properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string","description":"Session ID with existing L6 trajectory (16-char hex)"}},"required":["session_id"]}

resources.name: ActivateCapability
resources.desc: Promote a draft capability (draft -> active); active capabilities participate in Search matching; crystallized products must be activated before use

resources.name: RecordCapabilityUsage
resources.desc: Host feedback after a capability was used; updates success rate and trigger count

resources.name: ImportCapability
resources.desc: Import a memhop-capability/v3 capability file (single file, or a directory containing capability.json — format reference: capabilities/README.md); imported as active; same-name imports upsert (definition updated, stats preserved), byte-identical content is skipped; built-in cards need no import, ListCapabilities returns them directly

resources.name: ListCapabilities
resources.desc: List/filter capability cards (status/type/keyword filters); returns built-in read-only cards plus stored ones, each carrying its 16-char hex id for GetCapability

resources.name: GetCapability
resources.desc: Read one capability card's full definition by ID (including resource input JSON Schemas); fetch the detail before calling concrete APIs the first time a card is used

resources.name: UpdateCapability
resources.desc: Partially update a capability; nil patch fields are left unchanged (Name is immutable); built-in cards are read-only and updates are rejected

resources.name: DeleteCapability
resources.desc: Delete a capability record; built-in cards are read-only and deletion is rejected

steps.action: Crystallize a draft capability when trajectories suffice
Record success/failure feedback after each call
